public_rationale: This is a characterization, not a checkable fact. Saying Altman, Amodei and Suleyman 'have taken note' of Musk and 'play the same game' is a claim about their motives and strategy. Each has made bold public forecasts about AI. But whether that copies Musk's 'hype' playbook is a matter of judgment, with no agreed test. So the claim cannot be scored true or false.
limitations: I did not catalogue each CEO's predictions, because doing so would not settle a claim about intent.
